overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing colonist psychology decay curves for long-term stability, and establishing a zero-allocation event bus for endgame ascension triggers.

tasks.title: Deterministic State Hashing for Save Integrity
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a constexpr-friendly FNV-1a hash for struct-based state snapshots. Use std::array for fixed-size buffers. No dynamic allocation. Hash order must be stable across compiler versions. Integrate with existing I/O pipeline via template specialization for POD types.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Hash output is identical across 1000 runs. 2. Zero heap allocations during hashing. 3. Compile time < 50ms for 100 structs.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instant, reliable save/load cycles with no corruption warnings.

tasks.title: Optimized Psychology Decay Curves
tasks.architectural_spec: Replace iterative decay loops with closed-form exponential solutions using std::exp. Precompute lookup tables for common time steps (1, 5, 10 ticks). Use float precision for speed. Ensure monotonic convergence to baseline.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Decay values match reference within 1e-6. 2. 10x faster than iterative method. 3. No NaN propagation.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smoother, more predictable colonist mood transitions in long sessions.

tasks.title: Zero-Allocation Event Bus for Ascension
tasks.architectural_spec: Implement a fixed-capacity ring buffer for event dispatch. Use std::variant for event types. Dispatch via function pointers stored in a static array. No std::function overhead. Support 16 concurrent listeners.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 1. Dispatch latency < 10ns. 2. No heap allocations. 3. Handles 10k events/sec without drop.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Responsive UI updates during complex endgame sequences.
